title: AEGIS Response Schema
description: Schema for AEGIS [Reviewer] structured response back to ULTRON. Contains review verdict, categorized findings (critical/important/minor), and verification of VIGIL decisions and story tasks.

agent.description: Agent identifier — always 'aegis' for this response schema

status.description: Overall status of the review. 'success' = review completed fully, 'partial' = partial review, 'error' = could not review.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of the review verdict. Used by ULTRON for consolidation.

artifacts.description: Concrete review findings organized by severity and verification checks

verdict.description: Overall verdict: 'approved' = ship it, 'approved_with_issues' = ship with noted concerns, 'rejected' = must fix before proceeding (veto power)

description.description: Description of the critical issue (bugs, security flaws, data loss risks)

location.description: File path, function, or area where the issue was found

suggestion.description: Suggested fix for the critical issue

critical.description: Critical issues that block approval (triggers 'rejected' verdict)

location.description: File path, function, or area where the issue was found

important.description: Important issues that should be addressed (triggers 'approved_with_issues')

minor.description: Minor issues — style, naming, non-blocking suggestions

total.description: Total number of VIGIL strategic decisions that were verified

respected.description: Number of decisions correctly implemented by FORGE

violated.description: Number of decisions not respected or contradicted by the implementation

vigilDecisionsRespected.description: Verification of whether FORGE respected VIGIL's strategic decisions

total.description: Total tasks marked as completed in the story file

verified.description: Tasks whose completion was verified against actual output

mismatched.description: Tasks marked complete but whose output does not match expectations

tasksVerified.description: Cross-reference of story file task checkboxes vs actual implementation output

issues.description: Meta-issues about the review process itself (e.g. could not access certain files)

reviewDepth.description: Whether a full or quick review was performed

storyFileChecked.description: Whether the story file was used to cross-reference task completion

freeText.description: Optional free-text field for additional unstructured context (Phase 1 hybrid mode)

position.description: Agent's position in Deliberative Group Chat. Format: 'agree_with:{agent}', 'disagree', or 'propose:{alternative}'. Null when not participating in a group chat round.

vaultConsulted.description: Confirmation of the MANDATORY step-0 Vault consultation. True = AEGIS consulted the Vault paths in context.vaultPaths (or attempted and found them empty) BEFORE reviewing. False/absent = not consulted (only acceptable for a new project with an empty Vault). Optional for backward compatibility, but AEGIS MUST set it true on every mission.
